statements.impact_statement: Fixed in nginx 1.30.3 (and 1.31.2). The bundled matched-pair nginx IS 1.30.3 — the 1.30 stable-branch release that carries the fix. grype false-positive: the NVD CPE range (>= 1.13.10, < 1.31.2) sweeps the entire 1.30.x branch and does not carve out the 1.30.3 backport. Re-evaluate/update the pinned version when the bundled nginx (DEF_NGINX_VER, focal path in install/nginx/build_module_in_container.sh) is next bumped.
